limitations: Synthetic finite positive RGB and no MSAA only; no game shader or live routing qualification.
The diagnostic mode preserves classified failed comparisons and never qualifies packing.
Separate mode deliberately excludes all packed variants; original R1 and strict-flat R2 failures remain unchanged.
Separate mode selects effective flat/Gouraud CPU interpolation only from a fresh native-alpha FLAT/GOURAUD/FLAT classifier and verified Set/Get states; candidate RGB cannot select its oracle.
native_flat_conformance=false records backend divergence from documented flat COLOR semantics, not a universal flat-conformance pass.
Separate mode is resource-feasibility evidence and does not solve the ten-input Boron/Paranid originals; a zero filler is relocated for the authored reference.
TEX9 packed candidate is Gouraud with WRAP9=0; undefined mixed-semantic flat mode is never submitted.
COLOR1 non-PP full precision is inferred from combined SM3 contracts and tested against dedicated TEX and CPU, not merely separate COLOR1.
For classified effective-FLAT only, the full-TEX reference repeats first-vertex RGB while retaining original alpha/fog inputs and instruction words; R3 classified all cases effective-Gouraud.
64 float32-epsilon relative plus 1e-12 absolute is a fixed experimental envelope, not a universal hardware interpolation bound.
PP may execute at full precision; no PP/full difference is required. Native Windows runtime remains unverified.
Malformed declarations/context checks are host oracle refusals, not device validation claims.
Diagnostic correctness fixture only; no gameplay performance claim.
R1/R2 remain failed immutable runs. Packing diagnostic execution was intentionally skipped after abandoning that production route.
review: Same independent source/oracle/evidence reviewer approved R3; no open finding.
qualification_scope: Separate physical COLOR1 full RGB agrees with independently full TEX/CPU under native-effective interpolation; original COLOR0 PP alpha and temporal data remain exact. This is not native FLAT conformance or same-register packing qualification.

prior_failed_runs.label: same-register packing
prior_failed_runs.finding: All 28 shader creations succeeded; all 1,512 covered alpha lanes were 0x7fc00000 in each packed variant. Dedicated references preserved alpha. RGB and RT1/RT2 matched references. Packing was abandoned; the optional diagnostic mode was not executed.

prior_failed_runs.label: documented flat oracle
prior_failed_runs.finding: All 32 Gouraud cases passed. Under requested FLAT, native COLOR0 and separate COLOR1 instead matched Gouraud bit-for-bit. Pixel 520 red was 0.999800503254, with first-vertex expected 0.999755859375 and unchanged tolerance 7.6275328861e-6. R3 uses a fresh native-alpha classifier rather than widening tolerance.
